standard_prerequisites.name: Binomial series and integer divisibility
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Exact author binomial-series formula, Fact74 and Legendre Theorem76 retained.

core_obligations: Preserve all original constant-free, fixed-k, all-i, sufficiently-large-d and nonuniform conditions.
Retain complete integral-series proof and both full coefficient-product/factorization and ultimate-factorial derivations.
Retain author AppendixI algorithm; no sketch-only permanent consequence is a target.
difficulty_reason: The authors prove integrality with p-adic valuations, extract binomial coefficients from short truncation circuits, and form a factorial ratio computable by short straight-line programs. GCD interval searches then give nonuniform integer factorization; a separate recursion on factorial ratios bounds ultimate factorial complexity.

dedup.scope: Root source refresh zero. Theorems32/35 are the independent conditional algebraic-series hardness group; both coefficient-product consequences and all supporting integrality/algorithm details grouped, no support or direction splitting.
